ground_truth.note: Corrected per-scenario/per-host ground-truth files are preferred. Raw eCAR label remains audit-only until event-level reconciliation.

rules: All files for the same hostname must remain in exactly one split.
Vocabulary fitting is allowed only on rows with split=train.
Validation/test files must never affect vocabulary membership or frequency thresholds.
Ground-truth labels are used only for split stratification/audit, never as model features.
